title: Leita scheduled scans
description: Recorded scheduled-scan measurements. Adjust maximum age to each watched cadence; file generation time is not scan freshness. Charged bytes are not deletion savings. Directory and volume totals can overlap.

list.name: max_age_seconds
list.label: Maximum scan age (seconds)
list.description: Default 8 days permits weekly scans. Use a tighter value for hourly/daily schedules.

targets.expr: leita_monitor_scan_charged_bytes and on(job, instance, place) ((leita_monitor_scan_success == 1) and on(job, instance, place) (leita_monitor_scan_complete == 1) and on(job, instance, place) (leita_monitor_scan_synthetic == 0) and on(job, instance, place) (leita_monitor_scan_accounting_known == 1) and on(job, instance, place) (leita_monitor_scan_logical == 0) and on(job, instance, place) (leita_monitor_scan_order == 0) and on(job, instance, place) (((time() - leita_monitor_last_attempt_timestamp_seconds) >= 0) and on(job, instance, place) ((time() - leita_monitor_last_attempt_timestamp_seconds) < ${max_age_seconds:raw})))

panels.title: Volume free bytes (repeated across places sharing a volume)

targets.expr: leita_monitor_volume_free_bytes and on(job, instance, place) ((leita_monitor_scan_success == 1) and on(job, instance, place) (leita_monitor_scan_complete == 1) and on(job, instance, place) (leita_monitor_scan_synthetic == 0) and on(job, instance, place) (leita_monitor_scan_accounting_known == 1) and on(job, instance, place) (leita_monitor_scan_logical == 0) and on(job, instance, place) (leita_monitor_scan_order == 0) and on(job, instance, place) (((time() - leita_monitor_last_attempt_timestamp_seconds) >= 0) and on(job, instance, place) ((time() - leita_monitor_last_attempt_timestamp_seconds) < ${max_age_seconds:raw}))) and on(job, instance, place) (leita_monitor_volume_capacity_known == 1)

panels.title: Largest selected directories (overlapping; do not sum)

targets.expr: topk(10, leita_monitor_directory_charged_bytes and on(job, instance, place) ((leita_monitor_scan_success == 1) and on(job, instance, place) (leita_monitor_scan_complete == 1) and on(job, instance, place) (leita_monitor_scan_synthetic == 0) and on(job, instance, place) (leita_monitor_scan_accounting_known == 1) and on(job, instance, place) (leita_monitor_scan_logical == 0) and on(job, instance, place) (leita_monitor_scan_order == 0) and on(job, instance, place) (((time() - leita_monitor_last_attempt_timestamp_seconds) >= 0) and on(job, instance, place) ((time() - leita_monitor_last_attempt_timestamp_seconds) < ${max_age_seconds:raw}))))
